title: Chat with the agent: sessions and a durable agent
author: pratos with Claude Code
summary: Beside the plan document, Participants start a Session, ask the agent, and steer a Run while it works. The agent is a Participant too: `just agent-serve` signs in as itself, answers queued Runs in order through the same API, and survives `kill -9` by resuming its pi-durable conversation.
current: cp-05 has the plan document: Threads and Decisions in each PlanRoom's `events` table, the live socket, `resolve-thread` checked in `decide()`, and `just review`. Nobody can ask the agent anything, no route sets `by` from the sign-in, and `packages/agent` does not exist.
discoveries: Sessions run on the engine over the room's own SQLite (the `durableObject` adapter), so events and their projections commit in one transaction.
`StartSession` makes the agent a Participant from the start (`AGENT` in `session/decider.ts`), so the agent never has to join.
pi-durable finds a submission by `requestId`; with the Run id as `requestId`, a restarted agent resumes the same answer instead of asking twice.
The panel's server functions reach the API over the binding, but `agent-serve` and curl need an HTTP door: `/api` on the web origin.
With no model key, `chooseModelOrFaux` answers through pi-durable all the same, with a faux model that echoes the question.
endState: Signed in on `/plans/gh-12`, start a Session and ask; `just agent-serve` answers within seconds. A second browser joins and steers. Kill the agent mid-answer and start it again: the Run finishes once.
notDoing: Failing a Run after repeated errors; `FailRun` arrives in a later stage.
Tools for the agent; it answers in words, three sentences at most.
Running the agent inside the Durable Object; see the decision.
Renaming Session to Thread; that waits for the post-workshop rename.
Restyling the panel; cp-07 gives it bubbles and the theme's classes.
approach: Domain first, as stories, because the room, the panel and the agent all read Session events. Then the room and its signed-in routes, then the panel, and last the agent, which needs all three.

steps.caption: Sam asks, and the room queues a Run.
The agent, signed in as itself, starts the oldest queued Run.
It submits the question to pi-durable with the Run id as the request id.
Killed and restarted, it finds the same submission and resumes it.
It finishes the Run with the answer, recorded once.
Everyone on the plan sees each step as it lands.

options.label: As a Participant, through the API

decisions.why: The agent holds no command a person cannot issue, so it uses the same API. It can run anywhere with HTTP, and pi-durable's own store makes a kill -9 resume.

contract.code:
StartSession(sessionId, planId, by, title) → SessionStarted
JoinSession(sessionId, by)                 → ParticipantJoined
Ask(sessionId, by, asked)                  → RunQueued { runId }
StartRun(sessionId, runId, by)             → RunStarted     // the oldest queued, one at a time
Steer(sessionId, runId, by, steer)         → RunSteered     // any Participant, while it runs
FinishRun(sessionId, runId, by, result)    → RunFinished    // only whoever started it
EndSession(sessionId, by)                  → SessionEnded   // only the starter, nothing running
sessionStream(sessionId) = `session-${sessionId}`

phases.name: The agent as a Participant, durable
phases.goal: `just agent-serve` signs in as the agent, starts each Session's oldest queued Run, answers through pi-durable, and finishes it once, even after `kill -9`.

changes.intent: `tick` answers queued Runs in order; "/ask" answers are written into the plan.
One pi-durable conversation per Session; each Run submits with its id as `requestId`.
A `bun:sqlite` facade for pi-durable's portable SQLite storage; Bun has no `node:sqlite`.
`chooseModelOrFaux`: the provider whose key is set, else a faux model that echoes.

contract.code: chooseModelOrFaux(): { models: Models; model: ModelRef; faux: boolean }   // AGENT_MODEL=faux forces the faux model

changes.intent: Sign in as the agent, listen on the socket, write answers in with EditPlan.
Real engine, stand-in brain: answers in order, leaves a person's Run alone, resumes its own.
After a restart, the same Run comes from the store, with no second model call.
Add `agent-serve plan=gh-12`, and `agent-serve-reset` to forget the agent's store.
The answer replaces the "/ask" line, even in a list; other runs are not written.

manual.text: With `just up` and `just agent-serve`, a question is answered within seconds.
A second browser as Sam joins, asks and steers; both see the answer.
With a model key, `kill -9` agent-serve mid-answer and restart; one answer lands.

phases.notes: `serve.ts` reads `GREENHOUSE_URL` (default `http://localhost:3000/api`), `PLAN` (comma separated), `AGENT_EMAIL`/`AGENT_PASSWORD` (default `.dev.vars.example`) and `AGENT_STORE`. The faux model answers at once, so the kill test needs a real key.
